thread:
sara: FYI customer (acme-corp) opened an escalation — intermittent 502/504s from hosted API when using streaming inference for long responses (>45s). Seen across multiple regions. sample req id: rq_9a8b7c6d

eli: Got it. Any correlation ids or example timestamps?

sara: Pool of timestamps and ids in the ticket: 2026-02-15T15:09:32Z rq_9a8b7c6d, 2026-02-15T15:12:11Z rq_3f2e1a0b. They say client sees connection reset or "recv error: connection reset by peer" and then a 502 from our gateway downstream.

matt: Quick question — is this only for streaming (chunked + trailers) or also normal non-streamed gen?

sara: Customer says only streaming endpoints using function-call /v1/streams/generate. Non-streamed calls ok.

rina: Do we have any Envoy logs for those req ids?

eli: Pulling traces now — envoy shows upstream reset on one of the clusters: cluster: hosted-inference-default. Log line: "upstream reset before response completed" for rq_9a8b7c6d. Also saw HTTP/2 GOAWAY around same time from a midproxy instance.

infra-bot: deploy-bot reported a rolling restart in us-west-2-midproxy at 2026-02-15T15:08:55Z (image: midproxy:v3.14.2).

matt: Could be midproxy restart + long-lived streams -> stream reset + upstream thinks it finished and sends trailers -> proxy strips trailers -> client sees 502/504. We had similar behavior when response trailers arrived after connection-level GOAWAY.

sara: Customer provided a tcpdump from their side showing client saw FIN then RST shortly after last chunk. They also included a curl to reproduce: 

```bash
curl -v --http2 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -d @prompt.json \
  https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/streams/generate
```

eli: Ok can repro locally with a long response (60s). Reproduces when midproxy pod restarts during an in-flight stream. Envoy upstream logs show trailers accepted, but nginx frontdoor returns 502 with "upstream prematurely closed connection".

rina: Nginx (frontdoor) config has proxy_buffering on and proxy_http_version 1.1 by default for that layer — we push HTTP/2 to midproxy, but frontdoor downgrade path could be doing chunk aggregation and closing early.

matt: Actionable short term: 1) Suggest customer retry/backoff mitigation; 2) For Hosted, add a temporary routing rule to avoid midproxy rolling restarts (route to nodes not in that rolling set); 3) Instrument to capture full lifecycle (envoy, midproxy, frontdoor) for affected req ids.

sara: Customer already wants a workaround now (they're in prod). Can we do a per-tenant route pin to dedicated gateway (low friction)?

eli: I can push a routing override for acme-corp to prefer dedicated frontdoor in us-west-2 for the next 6 hours. Will need approval from infra.

matt: I'll collect kernel tcpdump + envoy conn logs from the midproxy that restarted. Need these artifacts: tcpdump around 15:08:40–15:12:40Z, envoy access log (with upstream_response_time and response_flags) and nginx error.log. I'll own log collection.

rina: I'll check frontdoor nginx config and see if proxy_ignore_client_abort / proxy_buffering tweaks would help. Also check whether we strip response trailers in the nginx upgrade path.

infra-bot: Requested nodes for log collection: midproxy-3a2b (pod id) accepted.

deploy-bot: Rolling restart of midproxy finished at 2026-02-15T15:10:02Z on node midproxy-3a2b. No errors in the healthcheck.

eli: Preliminary analysis: chain is Client -> Frontdoor nginx (HTTP/1.1 frontend, HTTP/2 to midproxy) -> Midproxy (HTTP/2) -> Envoy -> inference pod. When midproxy restarted, active HTTP/2 streams were being terminated with RST_STREAM/GOVAWAY and some trailers were delivered late by inference pod. nginx expects to have full response and may close connection if backend reset before trailers fully propagated. That results in 502 or 504 depending on timing.

sara: Does our runtime send response trailers for model metadata? We added a trailer with x-model-tokens and final-status recently for streaming.

matt: Yes, runtime emits a final trailer block with json metadata. That means late trailer delivery is part of the failure mode.

rina: Potential fixes: a) avoid sending critical info only via trailers (move to last chunk), b) make frontdoor tolerant of late trailers (config tweak), c) ensure midproxy drains streams gracefully on upgrade (drain timeout > longest expected stream).

eli: Short-term mitigation plan: 1) Route acme-corp away from midproxy rolling nodes (done by me, ETA 10m). 2) Temporarily disable trailer emission for hosted runtime for tenants with active streams (safe toggle, matt to coordinate). 3) Increase midproxy drain timeout to 90s for rolling restarts (infra to evaluate).

matt: I'll prepare a small runtime flag to inline final metadata into the last chunk instead of trailers. Can ship a hotfix that toggles per-tenant on the control plane.

rina: I'll prototype nginx config: set proxy_buffering off for streaming paths and enable proxy_ignore_client_abort on, and add "http2_max_field_size" knobs. Need to validate memory impact.

sara: Customer wants ETA for workaround. We should offer them immediate routing change + disable trailers for their tenant. ETA 20–30m?

eli: Done: routing override applied for acme-corp (us-west-2) at 2026-02-15T15:14:30Z. Notified customer.

matt: Pushed runtime toggle to disable trailers for acme-corp at 2026-02-15T15:22:10Z. Asked them to retry and share a new req id.

sara: Customer retried — new req id rq_f11e22dd at 15:25:40Z, they report success, no 502/504.

rina: Great signal. Still need a long-term fix: set drain timeout and change default to inline metadata. Recommend we track this as a reliability bug with severity P2 and schedule in next sprint.

eli: I'll open an infra ticket with details and attach traces + tcpdump + nginx/midproxy logs.

matt: I'll add an e2e test that simulates midproxy restart during active stream and validate trailers make it through.

sara: Customer happy with workaround for now and wants an update when permanent fix is scheduled. I'll own customer comms. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Created ticket INF-4823: "midproxy rolling restart + response trailers -> 502/504 on streaming endpoints". Assigned to eli/matt/rina.

deploy-bot: Notifying release leads about proposed drain-time change (90s) for midproxy clusters.

eli: Next steps summary (short):
- matt: e2e repro + runtime toggle (inflight) -> owner
- rina: frontdoor nginx config proposal + memory test -> owner
- infra: evaluate increasing midproxy drain timeout -> owner
- sara: customer comms + confirm closure after fix -> owner

sara: Thanks team. Marking as ongoing; will update customer and close once infra fixes are in. :pray:
